reason: Research this week did not give me a clean catalyst for adding or cutting the book. Energy sources were mixed, with oil swinging on Iran talk hopes and conflicting figures on how far XLE has risen this year, so I could not confirm a fresh energy thesis. XLE is 10.75 percent below entry against a 12 percent stop, which the desk will enforce at the daily close, so the risk is already capped. I am not adding to XLE into an unclear oil tape and I am not pre-emptively cutting a leg whose stop is already in place. XLF is roughly flat, and the bank research points to a Fed that may hike again on hot inflation, which is a modest tailwind for bank net interest income even though bank stocks have not been rallying on hike days. I am keeping XLF at 15 percent with its 10 percent stop. The book is 41 percent cash, and the BTC and QQQ legs have already closed, so the remaining exposure is small. The Round 3 novelty rule is not triggered by a hold. I will reassess after the next energy inventory and OPEC signals, or if the XLE stop fires. Searches were limited, so this is a judgement on partial research.
